exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Who's got brown, curly hair? brown, wavy hair? short grey hair? long straight fair hair? dark hair? a moustache? a beard and a moustache?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Kimda jigarrang jingalak soch bor? Jigarrang to'lqinsimon? Kalta kulrang? Uzun tekis oq-sariq? Qora soch? Mo'ylov? Soqol va mo'ylov?
exercises.explanationUz:
SOCH TA'RIFI qat'iy tartibda beriladi:
  UZUNLIK + SHAKL + RANG + hair
  'long straight fair hair' — uzun, tekis, oq-sariq soch

DIQQAT: 'Who's got' = 'Who has got' — qisqartma.
Soch haqida 'have got' ishlatiladi: 'She HAS GOT long hair'.

Yuz tuklari 'a' bilan keladi: a moustache (mo'ylov), a beard (soqol).

exercises.explanationUz:
Tashqi ko'rinish sifatlari:
• old — keksa · young — yosh · middle-aged — o'rta yoshli
• tall — baland bo'yli · short — past bo'yli
• slim — nozik · well-built — baquvvat · fat — semiz

DIQQAT: 'fat' qo'pol eshitiladi. Odob bilan aytish uchun
'a bit overweight' yoki 'large' ishlatiladi.

'quite' — ancha, birmuncha: 'quite tall' = ancha baland.

exercises.instructionUz: Yuzning qismlarini belgilang, so'ng o'z yuzingizda ko'rsatib nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHIM — ko'plik shakllari:
• eye → eyes (ikkita ko'z)
• ear → ears · cheek → cheeks · lip → lips
• tooth → TEETH (qoidasiz ko'plik!) — 'tooths' XATO

'lips' va 'mouth' farqi: lips — lablar (ikkita), mouth — og'iz (bitta).
'hair' odatda BIRLIKDA ishlatiladi: 'She has got long hair' ('hairs' emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words in the list to write the opposites of the phrases below. Now use some of these phrases to describe your partner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan quyidagi iboralarning teskarisini yozing. So'ng shu iboralar bilan sherigingizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Sifatlarning teskarisi (antonim) — juft holda yodlash eng oson:
  tall ↔ short (bo'y)
  slim ↔ fat (gavda)
  long ↔ short (soch uzunligi)
  straight ↔ curly (soch shakli)
  dark ↔ fair (soch rangi)
  full ↔ thin (lab)
  big ↔ small (burun, ko'z)

DIQQAT: 'short' IKKI ma'noda — past bo'yli VA kalta soch.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the colours. Which of these adjectives are often used to describe: a) hair? b) eyes? c) both?
exercises.instructionUz: Ranglarni belgilang. Bu sifatlardan qaysilari a) soch, b) ko'z, c) ikkalasi uchun ishlatiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Soch va ko'z rangi — cheklangan ro'yxat:
• FAQAT soch: fair (oq-sariq), red (qizg'ish-sariq)
• FAQAT ko'z: blue (ko'k), green (yashil)
• IKKALASI: brown, black, grey

DIQQAT: soch uchun 'yellow' ISHLATILMAYDI — 'fair' yoki 'blonde' deyiladi.
Ko'z uchun 'black' kamdan-kam — odatda 'dark brown' deyiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the Internet advertisements for pen-friends and answer the questions. Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Pen-friend (xat orqali do'st) uchun internet e'lonlarini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. So'ng qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'lon qolipi — har uchalasi bir xil tartibda:
1) Ism va yosh: My name's X and I'm ... years old.
2) Joy: I live in SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) Tashqi ko'rinish: I have got + SOCH + eyes. I'm + bo'y/gavda.
4) Qiziqish: I like / I love + -ing.
5) Qobiliyat: I can + FE'L.
6) Chaqiriq: Please e-mail me / Hope to hear from you soon.

Shu qolip bo'yicha o'zingiz ham e'lon yoza olasiz.

tasks.answer: He can play tennis very well.

exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi rasmda: oqish yuz rangi? och jigarrang teri? juda to'q teri va keng, yassiroq burun? qiyshiq qora ko'z va sarg'ish yuz rangi? to'q jigarrang ko'z va to'q teri?
exercises.explanationUz:
TERI va YUZ RANGI so'zlari:
• complexion — yuz rangi (teri emas, aynan yuzning ko'rinishi)
• pale — oqish, oqarinqiragan
• light brown skin — och jigarrang teri
• dark skin — to'q teri
• yellowish — sarg'ish (-ish qo'shimchasi 'ga moyil' degani)

BURUN va KO'Z:
• a wide, flattish nose — keng, yassiroq burun
• slanting eyes — qiyshiq (cho'ziq) ko'z

har bir odam haqida emas. Shuning uchun 'usually', 'most people', 'rather'
kabi yumshatuvchi so'zlar ishlatilgan.

Bu so'zlar tilda 'hedging' deyiladi — qat'iy da'vodan qochish.

sections.title: Grammar: have got ('ve got) / has got ('s got)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisements in Ex. 4 again and complete the sentences using: have, haven't, has or hasn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 4 dagi e'lonlarni qayta o'qing va gaplarni have, haven't, has yoki hasn't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki qadam:
1) EGAGA qarab have yoki has tanlang
   (Mario and Pierre = ular → have; Anna = u → has)
2) E'londagi ma'lumotga qarab tasdiq yoki inkor aniqlang.

tasks.whyUz: Pierre — bitta erkak → Has. E'londa soqol aytilmagan → hasn't.

tasks.prompt: : ___ Mario and Pierre got brown eyes?
tasks.whyUz: Ikki kishi → Have. Ikkalasining ko'zi ham jigarrang → have.
tasks.speak: : ___ Mario and Pierre got brown eyes?

tasks.whyUz: Ikki kishi → Have. Ikkalasining ko'zi ham jigarrang → have.
Anna — bitta ayol → Has. Uning sochi uzun → has.
Anna — bitta ayol → Has. Uning sochi uzun → has.
Annaning sochi oq-sariq (fair), jigarrang emas → hasn't.

tasks.prompt: : ___ Mario and Pierre got fair hair?
tasks.whyUz: Marioda jigarrang, Pierreda qora soch — ikkalasi ham oq-sariq emas → haven't.
tasks.speak: : ___ Mario and Pierre got fair hair?

tasks.whyUz: Marioda jigarrang, Pierreda qora soch — ikkalasi ham oq-sariq emas → haven't.

rule.explanationUz:
'have got' — 'bor' ma'nosini beradi (egalik).
O'zbekchada 'Menda it bor' deymiz — inglizchada 'I have got a dog'.

EGAGA qarab ikki shakl:
• I / you / we / they → HAVE got
• he / she / it → HAS got

Og'zaki nutqda qisqaradi: I've got, he's got.
DIQQAT: he's — bu 'he is' ham, 'he has' ham bo'lishi mumkin.
Farqni 'got' aytib beradi: 'he's got' = he HAS got.
rule.interrogativeNoteUz: Qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes, he has.' — 'Yes, he has got' emas.
rule.exampleEn: I've got a dog. My dog has got long ears.
rule.exampleUz: Menda it bor. Itimning quloqlari uzun.
rule.warningUz:
So'roqda 'do/does' ISHLATILMAYDI:
  'Has he got a car?' — TO'G'RI
  'Does he have got a car?' — XATO

exercises.instructionEn: Read the advertisements again. Copy the table below and complete it. Then, look at your notes and talk about the people, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: E'lonlarni qayta o'qing. Jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng yozganlaringizga qarab, namunadagidek odamlar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi 8 qator — 8 ta gapga aylanadi. Namunadagi tartibni saqlang:
1) yosh  2) qayerda yashaydi  3) soch va ko'z  4) bo'y va gavda
5) nimani yoqtiradi  6) nima qila oladi

DIQQAT — uchinchi shaxsda fe'l -S oladi:
• He LIVES in Paris (live emas)
• He LIKES playing (like emas)
Lekin 'can' dan keyin -s YO'Q: 'He can play'.

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures show people from the Wessex area who are missing. Look at their pictures and describe them. Listen and label them with their names from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarda Wessex hududidan bedarak yo'qolgan odamlar. Rasmlarga qarab ularni tasvirlang. So'ng eshitib, ro'yxatdagi ismlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Odamni tasvirlash tartibi (shu ketma-ketlikni saqlang):
  1) YOSH   — young / middle-aged / old
  2) BO'Y-GAVDA — tall, short, slim, well-built
  3) SOCH   — uzunlik + shakl + rang
  4) KO'Z   — rang
  5) BOSHQA — beard, moustache, glasses

Namuna: 'She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.'
exercises.audioNoteUz: Ismlar audio'dan eshitiladi. Audio bo'lmasa ham mashqning ASOSIY qismi — odamlarni tasvirlash — to'liq bajariladi (quyida har rasm tavsifi berilgan).

tasks.answer: She's young. She's got long straight black hair and green eyes.
He's old. He's got a white beard and a moustache. He wears glasses.
He's young. He's got short fair hair and blue eyes.
She's got long dark curly hair.
He's middle-aged. He's got short grey hair and a moustache.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose one of the people in Ex. 9 and describe him or her to your classmates. The student who guesses correctly chooses another person and the game continues.
exercises.instructionUz: Ex. 9 dagi odamlardan birini tanlab, sinfdoshlaringizga tasvirlang. To'g'ri topgan o'quvchi keyingi odamni tanlaydi va o'yin davom etadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu o'yin tasvirlash so'zlarini mustahkamlaydi. Ilovada siz topuvchi bo'lasiz: tavsif beriladi, siz qaysi odam ekanini aniqlaysiz.

O'yin so'zlari — ularni gapga qo'shib ishlating:
  young / middle-aged → 'He's middle-aged.'
  curly / long / straight → 'She's got long curly hair.'
  slim / well-built → 'He's well-built.'
  beard / moustache / big nose → 'He's got a beard.'

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birikib bitta sifat yasaydi. Chiziqcha SHART.
'like' va 'love' dan keyin fe'l -ing bilan keladi. Bu shakl mashg'ulot nomi ham bo'ladi.
Ba'zi so'zlar -s olmaydi, o'zagi o'zgaradi. Yodlab olish shart.
Tashqi ko'rinish sifatlarini JUFT holda yodlang — ikki barobar tez esda qoladi.

Sifatga -ish qo'shilsa, ma'no YUMSHAYDI: to'liq emas, shunga o'xshash.
Bu juda foydali qo'shimcha — istalgan rangga qo'shsa bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + SOCH TA'RIFI + hair
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have got short straight dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening kalta, tekis, qora sochim bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tartib QAT'IY: uzunlik → shakl → rang → hair.
'long straight fair hair' to'g'ri; 'fair long straight hair' XATO.
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → HAS got.
'eyes' doim KO'PLIK (ikkita ko'z). 'I have got a brown eye' — noto'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm quite tall and slim. / Mario is tall and well-built.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ancha baland va nozikman. / Mario baland va baquvvat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bo'y va gavda uchun 'be' ishlatiladi, 'have got' emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can play tennis very well. / She can play the piano.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l O'ZGARMAYDI: 'he can play' (plays emas), 'to' ham qo'yilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I love playing computer games. / I like reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'like/love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi. 'I like read' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a dog. / My dog has got long ears.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menda it bor. / Itimning quloqlari uzun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → has got.
O'zbekchadagi 'menda ... bor' shu qolipga to'g'ri keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Pierre got a beard? — No, he hasn't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l birinchi o'rinda. Qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'No, he hasn't' ('hasn't got' emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: TA'RIF (3 gap): EGA + be + bo'y/gavda. EGA + have got + soch/ko'z. EGA + can + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is quite tall and slim. He has got short dark hair and brown eyes. He can play tennis very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha baland va nozik. Uning kalta qora sochi va jigarrang ko'zi bor. U tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odamni ta'riflashning to'liq qolipi. Bo'y/gavda uchun BE, soch/ko'z uchun HAVE GOT, qobiliyat uchun CAN.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives in Paris. He likes reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Parijda yashaydi. U o'qishni yoqtiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: he/she/it bilan fe'lga -S qo'shiladi. LEKIN 'can' dan keyin qo'shilmaydi: 'He can play' (plays emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: Most people in JOY + are/have got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Most people in Mediterranean countries are rather short.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlarida ko'pchilik ancha past bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Most people' — ko'pchilik. Qat'iy 'all' o'rniga ishlatiladi, chunki hamma bir xil emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have usually got dark hair.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'usually' HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi: 'have usually got'. Bu tez-tez uchraydigan holatni bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do people from JOY look like?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do people from northern China look like?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — tashqi ko'rinishni so'rash. 'How do they look?' ham mumkin, lekin 'What ... look like?' odatiyroq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'do' ishlatiladi, chunki 'look' oddiy fe'l ('be' emas).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have also got dark brown eyes and full lips.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shuningdek to'q jigarrang ko'zi va to'la labi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'also' — shuningdek. U HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot berishda ishlatiladi.
